evidence.evidence_text: This has driven the development of “copyright takedown” methods—post-training approaches aimed at preventing models from generating content substantially similar to copyrighted ones.
We propose BloomScrub, a remarkably simple yet highly effective inference-time approach that provides certified copyright takedown.
The exposure of large language models (LLMs) to copyrighted material during pre-training raises concerns about unintentional copyright infringement post deployment.
By leveraging efficient data sketches (Bloom filters), our approach enables scalable copyright screening—even for large-scale real-world corpora.
